fields.description: Account holding deductible (input) VAT, e.g. 3452. Its debit balance is transferred to the VAT Assessment account.
fields.label: Deductible VAT Account

fields.description: Account holding output VAT, e.g. 3453. Its credit balance is transferred to the VAT Assessment account.
fields.label: Output VAT Account

fields.description: Account holding VAT withheld at source by customers, e.g. 34572. Its debit balance is transferred to the VAT Assessment account, so it is always left at zero — whether the assessment is payable or recoverable. Leave empty if the company has no withheld VAT.
fields.label: Withheld VAT Recoverable Account

fields.description: Clearing account where the period VAT is assessed, e.g. 3455.
fields.label: VAT Assessment Account

fields.description: Account for VAT payable to the state, e.g. 3456. Used when the assessment results in a payable (credit) position.
fields.label: VAT Payable Account

fields.description: Account for recoverable VAT, e.g. 3457. The transfer into this account is done the following month after AGT-portal verification.
fields.label: VAT Recoverable Account
